statement: There is a universal constant B4 ≥ 1 with the following property. Let G be a finite two-player game with entangled value v < 1, and fix a finite-dimensional strategy for k ≥ 1 repetitions. For C ⊊ [k] with pC = Pr(EC) > 0, put m = k − |C| and τ = log(1/pC) + |C| log(|A||B|) m . If τ ≤ 1, then 1 m X i/ ∈C Pr(Ii = 1 | EC) ≤ v + B4τ1/4 . (8)
